name: Uileog

facts.text: Uileog: level 40, a Fomorian body (model 827, size 125), faction Fomorian, at about 351,500/393,300 in the floor of Cruachan Gorge; respawn 300 seconds; a plain spawn.

Morven's Return (Cathbad of Howth): 'Ask Lucan about Morven's heirs', 'Slay Ronat, the first heir, east of Dun Lamfhota', 'Slay Uileog, the second heir', 'Slay Raemon, the third heir, at the cyclops tower'.

story:
Uileog is Morven's second heir, younger and smaller than Ronat and much less patient, and he keeps the floor of Cruachan Gorge among the curmudgeon puggards and the white boars, where the road runs. Where his elder brother watches, Uileog robs: he comes up out of the gorge floor at the hostings on their way to the keeps and takes what he can, cattle when the gorge had cattle, supplies now, and the gorge folk say he does it to make his father proud and that it has never once worked.

The keeners of Breifine say that if the heirs' line ever comes to Uileog, the frontier will have a Fomorian lord again who is worse than the old one, because Morven at least wanted something. Uileog only wants to be seen wanting it. His father has never once sent word that he is pleased. Uileog keeps robbing the road anyway, and the gorge folk have started leaving a little of every load at the roadside for him, to save the rest.
legend: Uileog (40) is Morven's second heir in the floor of Cruachan Gorge (about 351k/393k), among curmudgeon puggards (39-43) and rainbow sprites. Second kill of the heirs in Morven's Return. A group of 40ish handles him easily; watch the puggards on the slopes. 5-minute respawn. Frontier zone. Plain spawn, no script; the only danger is the puggards and sprites on the slopes, and enemy warbands using the gorge road. Do him second, after Ronat, as the quest says.

aggro: The road is mine, and what is on it.
slay: Did he see that? Did father see?

lairEntry: A young Fomorian in the gorge floor, by the road.
